about: Natal gear (本命) of the four founding Blossoms: always Divine, from Mahayana on, forged from ten fragments.

records.name: Snowplum Sword
records.effect: Frost Crescent strikes twice and each hit can Frost Seal: she turns from finisher to controller

records.name: Twin Violet Lightning
records.effect: Shadow Lightning Step readies all her techniques but costs 15% of her health: burst turns at a price

records.name: Jade Purity Vase
records.effect: Healing past full health becomes a Spirit Shield, so she protects even an unhurt team

records.name: Vermilion Feather Fan
records.effect: Fire Poison stacks up to 3 times on one enemy
